questions.stem: 對於有錯失恐懼症（fear of missing out, FOMO）的人而言，錯過任何訊息都令人焦慮，這讓他們手機不離手。
questions.answer: For those who suffer from FOMO, missing any message causes anxiety, which is why they never let their phones out of their hands.
accepted_answers: For those who have a fear of missing out, missing any message makes them anxious, which is why they never put down their phones.
For those who suffer from FOMO, missing any message is worrying, which is why their phones never leave their hands.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整句：這讓他們…）
對於…的人而言（For those who …）

questions.stem: 不斷推送訊息吸引使用者的應用程式，已被許多專家批評是在利用人們的焦慮。
questions.answer: Applications that keep sending messages to attract users have been criticized by many experts for taking advantage of people's anxiety.
accepted_answers: Apps which constantly push messages to draw users in have been criticized by many experts for making use of people's anxiety.
Applications that send out messages all the time to keep users coming back have been criticized by many experts for exploiting people's anxiety.

patterns: 關係代名詞子句（不斷推送訊息…的應用程式＝applications that keep sending …）
完成式被動（已被許多專家批評）

1.explanation_zh: 「對於…的人而言」用 For those who suffer from FOMO（those 是複數，動詞 suffer 不加 s）。「錯過任何訊息」是動作當主詞，寫成動名詞 missing any message；「令人焦慮」可寫 causes anxiety 或 makes them anxious（不能說 is anxious）。「這讓他們手機不離手」的「這」指前面整件事，用 , which is why they never let their phones out of their hands；「手機不離手」也可以寫 never put down their phones。
evidence: 對於有錯失恐懼症（fear of missing out, FOMO）的人而言
錯過任何訊息都令人焦慮
1.strategy_zh: 三段各有一個重點：For those who …、動名詞主詞 missing …、句尾 , which is why …。
hints: 切成四段：對於有錯失恐懼症的人而言／錯過任何訊息／都令人焦慮／這讓他們手機不離手
標的詞彙：message（訊息）、anxiety（焦慮）、phone（手機）
句型框架：For those who + V …, V-ing … + causes + N, which is why + S + V …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是「不斷推送訊息吸引使用者的應用程式」，修飾語很長，用關係子句放在 applications（apps）後面：Applications that keep sending messages to attract users（keep 後接動名詞，to attract 表目的）。「已被許多專家批評」用完成式被動 have been criticized by many experts；批評的理由用 for + V-ing：for taking advantage of people's anxiety（「利用」別人的焦慮是 take advantage of／exploit）。
evidence: 不斷推送訊息吸引使用者的應用程式
已被許多專家批評是在利用人們的焦慮
2.strategy_zh: 先找主要動詞（已被批評→have been criticized），其他的動作都放進關係子句或 for + V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：不斷推送訊息／吸引使用者／已被許多專家批評／是在利用人們的焦慮
標的詞彙：message（訊息）、application／app（應用程式）、user（使用者）、criticize（批評）、expert（專家）、anxiety（焦慮）
句型框架：N + that + V … + have been p.p. + by … + for + V-ing …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「手機不離手」要寫成完整的英文說法，例如 never put down their phones。

traps.explanation_zh: 「焦慮」可以是名詞 anxiety（causes anxiety）或形容人的 anxious（makes them anxious）；說事情本身 is anxious 是詞性和主詞都用錯。

traps.literal_error: For those who suffer from FOMO, miss any message causes anxiety.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿「錯過任何一則訊息」這個動作當主詞；英文要改成動名詞 missing any message。

bonus.text: So afraid of missing a single message are people with FOMO that they hardly ever let their phones out of their sight.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + adj. + be + S + that … 的倒裝強調焦慮的程度；let … out of one's sight 表「手機不離身」。只當加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「錯過任何訊息都令人焦慮」以動作當主詞，英文用動名詞 missing any message；「這讓他們…」的「這」指前面整件事，改成非限定關係子句 , which is why …。

traps.explanation_zh: 中文把很長的修飾語放在「應用程式」前面；英文要用關係子句 applications that keep sending messages … 放在名詞後面。

1.translation: For people with the fear of missing out (FOMO), missing any message makes them anxious, which is why they never put their phones down.
1.explanation_zh: 「對於…而言」用 For people with…；「錯過任何訊息」用動名詞片語當主詞；「這讓他們手機不離手」指前一整件事，用 which is why…；「手機不離手」意譯為 never put their phones down（也可 keeps them glued to their phones）。前半句 For people…, missing… makes them anxious 的 them 和 people 重複指涉，可接受但略冗。

2.translation: Apps that constantly send notifications to attract users have been criticized by many experts for taking advantage of people's anxiety.
2.explanation_zh: 「不斷推送訊息吸引使用者的應用程式」用 that 關係子句修飾 Apps；「已被許多專家批評」用現在完成被動式；「批評是在利用」用 criticize sb for V-ing；「利用」譯 take advantage of（也可 exploit）。「推送訊息」譯 send notifications，比 push messages 自然。

issues_zh: 我的盲譯開頭是 For people with the fear of missing out (FOMO)，沒有用到標的句型 REL（For those who …）。「有錯失恐懼症的人」是「有＋名詞」，英文最自然的說法是 people with FOMO，中文題目沒有引出關係子句；對照 871748 第 1 句「凡事都追求完美的人」有動詞「追求」，才自然引出 those who pursue …。

第 1 部分的 accepted 只收 those/people who suffer from/have …，正確又自然的 For people with FOMO 會被扣分，評分規準太窄。建議：第 1 部分補 For people with FOMO／For those with FOMO，並把這一句的 REL 換成別的標的句型；或改寫中文讓「…的人」帶動詞（例如「對於總是擔心錯過最新消息的人而言」），才會自然引出 who 子句。

第 1 部分「不斷推送訊息」的 accepted 只有 messages，沒有 notifications；「推送」在 app 的語境最自然的英文是 send (push) notifications（我的盲譯用 Apps that constantly send notifications）。target_words 已把 notification 列為 message 的 alternatives，accepted 也應補 Apps that constantly send notifications／that keep sending notifications 等寫法。
程式比對標的詞彙時，alternatives 的 notification 不會自動對到複數 notifications（詞形表沒有這個字），所以我說用了 message（換字 notifications），程式卻找不到；建議 alternatives 直接加上 notifications（比照 application 已列 apps）。

1.translation: For people with the fear of missing out (FOMO), missing any message makes them anxious, which keeps them glued to their phones.
1.explanation_zh: 「對於…的人而言」用 for people with …；「錯過任何訊息都令人焦慮」用動名詞當主詞 missing any message makes them anxious；『這讓他們手機不離手』的『這』指整個焦慮狀況，用 which 引導補充說明，keep sb glued to sth 表示手機不離手。『手機不離手』有多種譯法，所以信心給 medium。
